policy.title: Policy Title
policy.editorContent: FlashReel processes the information required for account registration, video upload, video review, public video display, likes, follows, view counting, and language settings according to this privacy policy. Users can request account deletion in settings. After deletion, the account will be anonymized and all videos published by the account will be taken down.
